prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a large high-end photorealistic digital product bundle hero mockup for a Brazilian violin sheet music shop, with TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND.
Inputs: images 1 through 5 are the existing approved product book covers to preserve and assemble into a richer bundle, NOT images to place side by side as a flat contact sheet.
Primary request: Transform these five separate books into one cohesive premium, abundant 3D product bundle composition. One dominant large upright main book in the center/back, with FOUR smaller bonus collection books arranged attractively around its lower left and right sides in a layered semicircle. The main book is significantly taller and wider than each bonus. Each is a substantial midnight NAVY leather hardcover with a visible spine, embossed GOLD borders, orange/white Music Library violinist logo, warm amber concert photographic violin artwork. Preserve the exact cover identities and numerical quantities from the inputs. Keep faces readable and recognizable. This is a realistic luxury product photography render, not a flat digital illustration.
Composition: wide LANDSCAPE composition approximately 3:2, tightly filled by the complete collection, all 5 books visible and none cut off, generous but small transparent margins. Center main book clearly above smaller books. At the bottom foreground, an elegant fan of several cream sheet music pages and an open music score, a small stylish navy audio playback tile with gold waveform and headphones icon, and a neat stack of scores. Warm polished violin wood and subtle concert light details PRINTED on the book covers. A physical violin scroll peeking behind the main book is acceptable as thematic decoration; no unrelated instruments. Soft realistic contact shadows under the entire bundle. Rich, dimensional, convincing full-package advertising, carefully balanced, high visual impact at 650px wide.
Exact book content: main book "ACERVO COM", "100 PARTITURAS", "PARA VIOLINO", and a small "42 SETLISTS" detail. The four bonus books: "18 PARTITURAS GOSPEL", "13 PARTITURAS MPB", "56 PARTITURAS POP INTERNACIONAL", "10 PARTITURAS CLÁSSICOS & TRILHAS". Preserve Portuguese spelling. All book branding says "music library.".
Constraints: exactly one main book plus exactly four bonus collection books; distinguish all 5 titles. No invented quantities, no 300, no 345, no monetary prices, no additional products such as a transposition app, no physical shipping box or gift box, no people, no UI surrounding the composition, no heading outside the products, no watermark. Do not put a solid dark/white backdrop behind the bundle. Preserve true transparent alpha in the outer background. Maintain a cohesive navy/gold/orange palette and warm dramatic studio lighting. This is an illustrated presentation of the digital materials.
